items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Danny' in the context of a paddock worker, but the interviewee (Lionel Ferbos) does not respond to or acknowledge this mention, nor does he mention Danny in his own narrative.

ctx.x: That fellow that was working the paddock.

That's for him first. Well naturally he got an every night job and that's all he'd do for a living. So he took an every night job. And Lionel told me, he said, I know a good piano player. I played with him before. He named him Smitty, he said. No Wiggins played before Smitty. No Wiggins, yeah Wiggins. Not Frank Moyer. Frank Moyer, Wiggins, and then Smitty. Wiggins didn't stay, well Wiggins didn't stay long. Because he went on another job. Yeah he went on another job. And then we got Smitty. And Smitty stayed…
